facts.fact: Adwave's cadence table says a well-built autopilot system optimizes audiences and funnel movement hourly.
facts.quote: **Hourly** | Audiences and how people move through the funnel

facts.fact: Adwave's cadence table says a well-built autopilot system optimizes budget allocation, creative performance, and bids daily.
Adwave's cadence table says a well-built autopilot system optimizes the customer journey and channel mix weekly.
facts.quote: **Weekly** | The customer journey and channel mix

facts.fact: Adwave's cadence table says a well-built autopilot system runs a monthly holdout readout to check what is incremental.
facts.quote: **Monthly** | A holdout readout to check what's incremental

facts.fact: Adwave states it buys media across Meta, Google, Reddit, TikTok, web, mobile, and television from one budget.
facts.value: Meta, Google, Reddit, TikTok, web, mobile, television
facts.quote: buys the media across Meta, Google, Reddit, TikTok, web, mobile, and television, and optimizes on autopilot from your own site data, all from one budget

facts.fact: Adwave states that it builds ads from the advertiser's website and that the advertiser approves them before spend.
facts.quote: It builds the ads** from your website, brand-matched, and **you approve them before you spend**.

facts.fact: Adwave's autopilot optimizes campaigns on hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly cadences and logs every change it makes.
facts.quote: It optimizes on a real cadence** (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly) and **logs every change**

facts.fact: Adwave's prepaid model has the user fund a wallet and set a daily spending ceiling, with no contract required.
facts.quote: you fund a wallet, set a daily ceiling, and never sign a contract

facts.fact: Adwave's autopilot guarantees the building, buying, and optimizing process rather than a specific outcome.
facts.quote: It guarantees the process, not the outcome.

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance is to review ads the autopilot builds before anything spends, as a quality gate.
facts.quote: Review what it builds before anything spends. This is your quality gate.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests evaluating autopilot performance over roughly the first two weeks, looking at trends rather than single days.
facts.quote: look at the trend over two weeks rather than the noise of any single day
